name: Cute Elephant Pattern Wooden Clipboard
seoTitle: Cute Elephant Clipboard for Nursing Students
metaDescription: A cute elephant pattern wooden clipboard with a low profile clip. A budget friendly gift for nursing students who need a writing surface in clinicals.
summary: A sweet elephant print clipboard with a low profile clip, a small and useful gift for a nursing student heading into clinicals.
whyItWorks: Clinical rotations involve a lot of writing while standing: report sheets, assessment notes, and care plan scribbles taken at the bedside or in the hallway. A clipboard gives students a firm surface to work on, and a cute elephant pattern makes it easy to spot their board in a pile at the nurses station.

The low profile metal clip keeps papers flat without a bulky top, which helps when sliding the board into a bag. Standard letter size works for typical worksheets and forms. It is budget friendly, so it fits a back to school care package, a white coat or capping ceremony gift, or an add on to a nursing supply bundle. School nurses and nurse educators who run screenings or teach skills labs can use one too. Pair it with fine black pens and a penlight for a ready to go clinical kit.
goodToKnow: It is a decorative clipboard, so check the listing for whether it has storage, since the title does not mention it.
The size is listed as standard A4 at about 9 by 12.3 inches, so it will not fit in a scrub pocket.
Many hospital nurses use folding pocket boards instead, so this suits students and educators best.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a nursing student?
faq.a: Yes, students use clipboards constantly in clinicals and skills labs, and the cute design makes it feel personal.

faq.q: Does it come in other designs?
faq.a: The title lists a lovely elephant design, so check the listing if you want a different pattern.
